title: FoTo: Targeted Visual Topic Modeling for Focused Analysis of Short Texts
subcategory: targeted topic model with joint 2-D visualisation
task: Finding and visualising topics relevant to user keywords in short texts
problem: Short-text sparsity yields weak topics, and full-corpus topic models do not focus on the aspects a user cares about.
architecture: Generative model in which topics and documents get coordinates in a visualisation space (topic coordinates from topic embeddings; word distributions softmax over word embeddings); documents draw topics from distance-based probabilities; user aspects are embedded as points, and a pairwise document-ranking likelihood keeps documents relevant to an aspect closer to it; skip-gram word embeddings reduce sparsity.
metrics: sum of averaged cosine similarity to query keywords (SOAC)
key_results: Authors report FoTo 'consistently achieves the highest SOAC value in most settings' (Figure 4), while targeted models TTM and QDTM perform comparably to non-targeted ones.
Four queries per dataset mixing popular and rare aspects (e.g. SEARCHSNIPPET Q3 = sporting, athlete, racing).
strengths: Unifies targeted topic modelling and document visualisation in one generative model.

limitations.text: Designed for short texts; extension to general texts left for future work.
Results are reported in figures only, so exact values are not available for comparison.
